payload.name: Infer social connections from activities and memberships
payload.description: When a question asks whether a person has friends or companions besides a named individual, search activities, teams, and group memberships before concluding no.
content: When a question asks whether a subject has friends or social connections besides a named person, do not treat the absence of explicit 'friend' memories mentioning other people as proof of no friends.

After any initial retrieval focused on the named person, run one additional hybrid and one structured search using the subject's name with keywords for activities and group contexts (e.g., team, club, tournament, group, class, teammate, member, participated, won) and memory_kinds=['event','relationship','profile','state'].

If a retrieved memory shows the subject participating in a team, tournament, class, club, or recurring group activity, answer that it is likely they have friends or companions from that context, citing that memory.
Stop after one additional targeted search that returns no such activity or membership memories; avoid exhaustive expansion.

solves: When a question asks whether a person likely has friends or companions beyond a named individual, the agent searches only for explicit friend relationships involving that named person, missing evidence of social connections implied by activities, teams, clubs, or group events. This skill directs a targeted search for activity and membership contexts before concluding no friends exist.
